verdicts.reason: A: the headline is strong and nothing collides, but the RSVP CTA has shrunk to a small pill the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS badges, so the CTA is buried. The three middle columns (tagline, date, URL) are ragged, and the legal text and URL are tiny. B: the centred headline and the large RSVP button give a clear hierarchy, but the right column is jammed against the edge: the FREE ENTRY and ALL AGES badges overlap, ALL AGES is clipped off the canvas, and the missing-asset box collides with the date. The legal text floats in the middle and the left third is dead space. A wins narrowly because it has no collisions or clipping.
